card.name: Start of 'gal' in word beginnings
card.fires_on: A word-start 'g' or 'G' (often after a hyphen or space) where the word is about to continue as 'gal-', such as gallstones, galactose or gallery.

modes.label: Galactose and gallstones
modes.description: The 'g' that opens gallstones or the 'g' after a hyphen in glucose-galactose.

modes.label: Gallery in web menus
modes.description: The capital G starting GALLERY in photo or media menu labels.
modes.example: MORE IN Vermont News - Most Popular - Most Emailed - MEDIA<< G>>ALLERY

modes.label: Other gal- names
modes.description: The G opening names like Gallia or Galleria.
modes.example: Uffizi GalleryArticle Free Pass Uffizi Gallery, Italian<< G>>alleria degli Uffizi, art

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'gal', 'Gall' and 'gallery' as the next piece of the word.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter 'g' when the word being spelled out is a gal- word like galactose, gallstones or gallery.
